
# 1st Priority: The VERSION file

echo "0.1.13-dev1" > VERSION

# 2nd Priority: VERSION in generated by ./SIETIUM-VERSION-GEN

./SIETIUM-VERSION-GEN version

It will USE version in VERSION if it exists and valid.

# 3rd Priority: Assign in package.sh cmdline

## 3.1 get version from SIETIUM-VERSION-GEN

./ci-scripts/package.sh release

## 3.2 get version from cmdline

./ci-scripts/package.sh release 0.1.13-dev2
./ci-scripts/package.sh mr ...
./ci-scripts/package.sh daily ...

# Trouble shooting

If your version isn't expected, please rewrite or clean VERSION file.

# Release Engineer needs to update VERSION info in SIETIUM-VERSION-GEN

```
Filename: ./SIETIUM-VERSION-GEN

#!/bin/bash

####### RELEASE VERSION INFO ########
PRODUCT=sietium-kmod-mesa-drv
VERSION=0.1.14-dev
stage_version=-beta

# example: 0.1.13-230803-709bd84-beta
#####################################
```
